Deepti Mishra  
Email: deepti.mishra@adtechinnovations.com | Tel Aviv, Israel | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/deepti-mishra | GitHub: github.com/deeptimishra  

Education  
B.Sc. in Computer Science, Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, 2015  

Professional Experience  
At AdScale Dynamics, I spearheaded a multi-cloud infrastructure strategy that reduced operational overhead by 30% through Terraform-driven automation. This involved designing CI/CD pipelines with ArgoCD, which enabled seamless deployment across AWS and GCP environments. My work also included refining incident response protocols, ensuring 99.95% system uptime during peak ad-tech traffic. Previously, at AdTarget Solutions, I led SLO management for real-time ad-serving systems, aligning engineering priorities with business KPIs. I introduced Prometheus-based monitoring to track latency metrics, which reduced mean time to resolution for critical outages by 40%. Early in my career at AdServe Technologies, I automated deployment pipelines using Jenkins, optimizing Linux server performance to cut cloud costs by 15%.  

Professional Summary  
With nine years of experience in ad-tech DevOps and SRE, I have focused on building resilient, scalable systems that balance performance with cost efficiency. My work spans infrastructure automation, monitoring architecture, and team leadership, with a particular emphasis on cloud-native solutions. I thrive in environments where operational reliability and innovation intersect, and I take pride in mentoring engineers to adopt best practices in CI/CD and observability.  

Projects  
1. **Multi-Cloud Migration Framework**: Developed a Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code solution for transitioning ad-tech platforms from monolithic to microservices architecture, reducing deployment friction by 50%.  
2. **Real-Time Monitoring Dashboard**: Designed a Prometheus/Grafana integration to visualize ad-serving system performance, enabling proactive scaling during traffic spikes.  
3. **Linux Automation Scripts**: Created a suite of bash and Python scripts to streamline server provisioning, reducing manual tasks by 60% across 50+ nodes.  
4. **CI/CD Pipeline Optimization**: Redesigned AdScale’s pipeline using GitHub Actions, cutting deployment latency from 45 to 15 minutes while improving security through automated code reviews.  

Publications  
- *“Cloud Cost Optimization in AdTech: A Case Study”* (2022) — Co-authored whitepaper on leveraging infrastructure automation to reduce cloud spend without compromising scalability.  

Volunteer / Open Source  
Contributed to the open-source project *kube-bench* to enhance Kubernetes security compliance checks. Also, mentored junior DevOps engineers at a local tech meetup, focusing on best practices for monitoring and CI/CD pipeline design.
